answer: To deter Sybil control, the protocol links bonded escrows when evidence shows coordinated equivocation: for k implicated identities, the penalty grows as O(k²), reflecting pairwise coordination rather than treating each signer independently. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the swarm, with asymmetric depreciation making recovered collateral worth less than its face value. A meadow, anchor, and timber may label test accounts, but labels do not sever cryptographic links or evade slashing.
